name: IOPS
short_description: IOPS (input/output operations per second) measures how many read or write requests a storage system can handle each second.

evidence.quote: Iops stands for input and output operations per second.
each account had caps on IOPS and throughput, go over those caps, and your application would throttle.
Three factors determine performance. I/OPS, throughput and latency.
Inconsistent IOPS is another issue. It frustrates VDI users the most.
